title: Resignation of registered agent.
bodyText: A registered agent may resign from the registered agent's appointment by complying with the requirements of section 425R-10.
bodyHtml: §414D-73  Resignation of registered agent.  A registered agent may resign from the registered agent's appointment by complying with the requirements of section 425R-10. [L 2001, c 105, pt of §1; am L 2012, c 58, §7]
